hyperedges.label: Task Processing Pipeline
hyperedges.description: TaskManager orchestrates the full task lifecycle by routing via Router, notifying via EventBus, persisting context via ContextManager, and executing via AgentRegistry. Each state transition emits a typed event for auditability.

hyperedges.label: Gateway Bootstrap Sequence
hyperedges.description: main() initializes the gateway in dependency order: load config → configure router with rules and default agent → initialize agent registry → register all agents into router → initialize vector store (async) → subscribe to all event types for logging.

hyperedges.label: Universal Message Protocol
hyperedges.description: AgentMessage is the single communication primitive flowing through all core components. EventBus publishes typed events wrapping AgentMessage, ContextManager persists AgentMessage arrays in three-tier storage, TaskManager creates and routes AgentMessage requests. correlation_id enables distributed tracing.

hyperedges.label: Gateway Resilience Layer
hyperedges.description: Three complementary fault-tolerance mechanisms: circuit breaker prevents cascading failures by disabling unhealthy providers, retry with exponential backoff + jitter handles transient upstream errors, and rate limiter prevents abuse and overload. All three are applied in the request path through model_gateway_routes.

hyperedges.label: Provider Selection Pipeline
hyperedges.description: Three-step provider selection: 1) model_router resolves routing rules, 2) circuit_breaker_registry.isOpen filters out unhealthy providers, 3) quota_manager.isProviderAvailable filters out providers with exhausted quota (specifically Codex Plus for the openai provider). Only providers passing all three filters are returned.

hyperedges.label: Gateway Request Processing Pipeline
hyperedges.description: Full request lifecycle: rate_limiter.checkRateLimit → model_router.resolveProvider → model_router.remapModel → model_provider_caller.callChatCompletions (which internally checks circuit_breaker_registry.canRequest and wraps the fetch in retry_config.withRetry, then records success/failure to circuit_breaker_registry) → gateway_metrics.recordRequest logs the outcome. This pipeline handles both chat completions and responses endpoints.

hyperedges.label: Adapter Pattern Hierarchy
hyperedges.description: AgentAdapter interface → BaseAgentAdapter abstract class → three concrete adapters (ClaudeCodeAdapter, OpenClawAdapter, ProcessAdapter) all following the same invoke/invokeStream/health contract

hyperedges.label: Hermes Async Webhook Flow
hyperedges.description: POST /hermes/task accepts prompt → creates HermesTask (202 Accepted) → async executeHermesTask calls model_gateway_router (resolveProvider + remapModel) → calls model_gateway_providers (callChatCompletions) → updates task status

hyperedges.label: SSE-Based Real-time Event System
hyperedges.description: SSE endpoint /events → subscribes clients to task_manager task status updates + agent_registry agent info → 30s heartbeat keepalive → broadcast endpoint forwards to all connected clients

nodes.label: AgentRegistry
nodes.rationale: Config-driven agent registration with fallback to built-in defaults; supports 25+ AI tools via ProcessAdapter wrapping CLI commands; config takes precedence over defaults, enabling user customization without code changes

nodes.label: loadConfig
nodes.rationale: Upward config search from current file location with 10-level parent directory traversal; caches result to avoid repeated file I/O; merges YAML with DEFAULT_CONFIG for partial overrides

nodes.label: ContextManager
nodes.rationale: Three-tier memory architecture: L1 in-memory Map for sub-millisecond access, L2 file-system JSON persistence for durability, L3 ChromaDB vector store for semantic search; each tier added asynchronously without blocking the hot path

nodes.label: EventBus
nodes.rationale: Pub/sub event-driven architecture decouples agent lifecycle, task lifecycle, and context updates; components emit typed events without direct knowledge of listeners; max 100 listeners prevents memory leaks

nodes.label: Logger
nodes.rationale: Dual-output logging: console (stderr) for development plus optional file persistence via Bun.write; supports Pino delegation for production-grade structured logging; log level filtering with LOG_LEVELS numeric comparison

nodes.label: Router
nodes.rationale: Priority-ordered keyword matching with deterministic fallback: try rules sorted by priority desc → default agent → broadcast to all online agents → empty (no agent available); supports both direct (single agent) and broadcast (multi-agent) strategies

nodes.label: TaskManager
nodes.rationale: Central orchestrator implementing a 5-step task pipeline: create → add to context → route → assign+start → execute (direct or broadcast); each state transition publishes an event via EventBus for audit and external observation

nodes.label: VectorStore
nodes.rationale: ChromaDB-backed semantic search for agent context; gracefully degrades when ChromaDB is unavailable (isAvailable check); messages are vectorized by concatenating task, result, and error fields into a single text document

nodes.label: main (Gateway Server)
nodes.rationale: Fastify-based HTTP + WebSocket gateway; initializes all core components in dependency order (config → router → agentRegistry → vectorStore → eventBus); dynamically imports hermes routes and model-gateway quota; supports CORS for browser access

nodes.label: CLI main
nodes.rationale: Unified CLI for start, setup, health, models, quota, connect, disconnect, release, hermes, and doctor commands; communicates with running gateway via HTTP API; dynamically lazy-loads sub-modules to keep startup fast

nodes.label: ToolAdapter
nodes.rationale: Pluggable adapter interface for AI tool integration: detect → read → generate → configure; supports TOML, JSON, JSON-merge, YAML, and shell-env formats; automatic backup before modification enables safe disconnect

nodes.label: Gateway Configuration (gateway.yaml)
nodes.rationale: Single YAML file configures agents, routing rules, model gateway providers, circuit breaker, retry, and rate limiting; supports 25+ agent definitions with keyword-based routing rules in both English and Chinese

nodes.label: Circuit Breaker Registry
nodes.rationale: Implements the circuit breaker pattern (CLOSED→OPEN→HALF_OPEN) to prevent cascading failures by temporarily disabling providers that exceed a configurable failure threshold. HALF_OPEN allows limited probe requests after a reset timeout to test recovery before fully re-enabling.

nodes.label: Provider Health Check
nodes.rationale: Health checks each provider by calling /models endpoint; uses a 30-second cache TTL to balance freshness with performance. Short-circuits to 'unhealthy' immediately if the circuit breaker is OPEN for that provider, avoiding unnecessary network calls.

nodes.label: Gateway Runtime Metrics
nodes.rationale: Collects per-provider request/success/failure/latency metrics and keeps a sliding window of 200 most recent request logs. Exposes aggregated statistics including success rates and uptime.

nodes.label: Model Provider API Caller
nodes.rationale: Core provider invocation layer that sends requests to upstream LLM APIs. Wraps calls with circuit breaker checks and retry logic. Handles special provider headers (e.g., OpenRouter requires HTTP-Referer and X-Title).

nodes.label: Quota Manager
nodes.rationale: Probes provider quotas via the external codexbar CLI, parsing provider-specific formats (credits, balance, usage percentages). Uses a 60-second cache TTL and gracefully falls back to stale data on probe failure, assuming availability on parse errors to avoid false negatives.

nodes.label: Token Bucket Rate Limiter
nodes.rationale: Per-endpoint-per-IP token bucket rate limiting. Default limits: 60 rpm for chat completions, 30 rpm for responses. Stale buckets (inactive >5min) are cleaned up on a 60-second timer to prevent memory leaks.

nodes.label: Retry with Exponential Backoff
nodes.rationale: Exponential backoff with 75-125% jitter to prevent thundering herd on upstream recovery. Default: 3 retries, 500ms base, 10s cap. Only 429/5xx status codes are considered retryable (excludes 4xx client errors).

nodes.label: Model Router
nodes.rationale: Resolves external model names to concrete providers with a three-tier fallback strategy: 1) prefix-pattern routing table (model_routing), 2) global fallback chain, 3) first available provider with an API key. Skips providers that are circuit-breaker-open or have exhausted Codex Plus quotas. Supports model name remapping per-provider (e.g., gpt-5.3-codex→deepseek-v4-pro).

nodes.label: Model Gateway HTTP Routes
nodes.rationale: Central orchestration layer that wires all gateway modules into Fastify HTTP routes. Request flow: rate-limit check → resolve provider → remap model → call upstream (with circuit breaker + retry) → log metrics. Exposes OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions and Codex Desktop /v1/responses endpoints, plus management endpoints for health, quota, and stats.

nodes.label: Model Gateway Type Definitions
nodes.rationale: Central type definitions shared across the entire model-gateway module, defining config structures (ModelProviderConfig, ModelGatewayConfig), runtime types (ResolvedProvider, QuotaInfo), and request types (ChatCompletionRequest, ResponsesRequest).

nodes.label: Codex Responses-to-Chat Adapter
nodes.rationale: Translates Codex Desktop's Responses API format to OpenAI Chat Completions format and back. Converts multi-type input messages (message, function_call, function_call_output) to chat format, transforms tool schemas, and maps SSE stream events (output_text.delta, function_call_arguments.delta, completed).

nodes.label: Codexbar CLI Quota Probe
nodes.rationale: External CLI tool (codexbar usage --format json --provider all) spawned via Bun.spawn to retrieve live quota data. Must be installed separately; quota manager gracefully degrades on probe failure.

nodes.label: Agent Router (Core)
nodes.rationale: Keyword-priority-based agent routing at the core layer. Routes AgentMessages to the highest-priority matching online agent, with fallback to a default when no rule matches or all matching agents are offline. Separate from the model-gateway router.

nodes.label: Context Manager (Core)
nodes.rationale: Manages shared memory spaces with unique IDs and metadata storage. Supports create and retrieve operations for cross-agent context sharing.

nodes.norm_label: connect command (interactive ai tool detection & configuration)
